events.label: US-Venezuela oil and gas stake negotiations

slots.name: Venezuelan oil reserves
slots.unit: billion barrels of proven crude oil reserves in Venezuela
slots.sentence: Venezuela has the world’s largest proven crude oil reserves with an estimated 303bn barrels, compared with Saudi Arabia’s 268bn and Iran’s 208bn.

slots.name: Oilfield lease term
slots.sentence: Bloomberg, citing sources familiar with the negotiations, said one deal under discussion was a 100-year lease on several oilfields.

slots.name: negotiated oil reserves
slots.unit: billion barrels in oilfields under discussion
slots.sentence: On Thursday, the Wall Street Journal said Trump officials were in “advanced talks” with Venezuelan officials to take “a direct stake in more than a dozen oilfields” containing 90bn barrels, nearly a third of Venezuela’s energy reserves.

slots.name: U.S. venture control
slots.sentence: The U.S. government will control 55% of the joint venture, split between equity in the venture and the ability to obtain oil from it at cost, the official said.
